formats.key: redeemInstant(address tokenOut, uint256 amountMTokenIn, uint256 minReceiveAmount, address recipient)
effects: The signer gives up amountMTokenIn of the vault's mToken. The vault burns amountMTokenIn minus the fee from the signer, or sends it to the liquidity provider on the swapper path.
The vault takes a fee in mToken (token fee plus instant fee, read from storage) from the signer and sends it to feeReceiver with transferFrom. This spends the signer's mToken allowance to the vault.
Only amountMTokenIn minus the fee is converted to tokenOut at the oracle rates.
The recipient receives tokenOut. The amount is at least minReceiveAmount, which is in 18 decimals.
formats.shown: Intent 'instantly redeem' with the receive token, the mToken amount as a bare 18-decimal number with no ticker, the minimum received as a bare 18-decimal number, and the receiver.

findings.title: redeemInstant (with recipient) shows the redeemed amount with no mToken name or ticker.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json: field 'Amount to redeem', format unit, params {"base": " ", "decimals": 18}. RedemptionVault._redeemInstant: mToken.burn(user, calcResult.amountMTokenWithoutFee), where mToken is the vault's own token from storage.
findings.fix: Split the descriptor into one file per mToken vault. Set the unit base to the ticker, for example "mTBILL", or use tokenAmount with a token constant.

findings.title: redeemInstant (with recipient) does not say that a mToken fee goes to feeReceiver before conversion.
findings.evidence: RedemptionVault._redeemInstant: if (calcResult.feeAmount > 0) _tokenTransferFromUser(address(mToken), feeReceiver, calcResult.feeAmount, 18); amountTokenOutWithoutFee is computed from calcResult.amountMTokenWithoutFee. The descriptor has only the label 'Amount to redeem'.
findings.fix: Change the label to 'Amount to redeem (fee included)'. Or change the intent to 'Redeem mToken (minus fee) instantly'.

findings.title: redeemInstant (with recipient) minimum received is in 18 decimals, so it cannot use the receive token's format.
findings.evidence: RedemptionVaultWithUSTB._redeemInstant comment: 'minReceiveAmount minimum expected amount of tokenOut to receive (decimals 18)'. descriptor.json: 'Min receive amount' uses unit with decimals 18 and base " ".
findings.fix: Change the label to 'Min receive amount (in receive token)'.

formats.key: redeemInstant(address tokenOut, uint256 amountMTokenIn, uint256 minReceiveAmount)
effects: The signer gives up amountMTokenIn of the vault's mToken. Most of it is burned, or sent to the liquidity provider on the swapper path.
The vault takes a fee in mToken (token fee plus instant fee, from storage) from the signer and sends it to feeReceiver. This spends the signer's mToken allowance to the vault.
Only amountMTokenIn minus the fee is converted to tokenOut at the oracle rates.
The signer receives tokenOut. The amount is at least minReceiveAmount, which is in 18 decimals.
formats.shown: Intent 'instantly redeem' with the receive token, the mToken amount as a bare number with no ticker, and the minimum received as a bare number.

findings.title: redeemInstant shows the redeemed mToken amount with no token name. Case 0 hides that it is mTBILL.
findings.evidence: Case 0: the signer sends 2407.570471241997755491 mTBILL (signerNet -2407570471241997755491). The screen shows 'Amount to redeem: 2407.570471241997755491 ' with no ticker. descriptor.json: unit base " ".
findings.fix: Split the descriptor per mToken vault. Set the unit base to the mToken ticker, or use tokenAmount with a token constant.

findings.title: redeemInstant does not say that part of the amount is a mToken fee sent to feeReceiver.
findings.evidence: Case 0: 1.685299329869398428 mTBILL goes from the signer to 0x0b831fac…dab (feeReceiver), and the rest is burned. RedemptionVaultWithUSTB._redeemInstant: _tokenTransferFromUser(address(mToken), feeReceiver, calcResult.feeAmount, 18). The screen shows only 'Amount to redeem'.
findings.fix: Change the label to 'Amount to redeem (fee included)'.

findings.title: redeemInstant spends the signer's existing mToken allowance to the vault for the fee. The screen does not say so.
findings.evidence: Case 0: approval event for mTBILL from the signer to the vault, new allowance 2405885171912128357063, after transferFrom of the fee. ManageableVault._tokenTransferFromUser: IERC20(token).safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, to, transferAmount).

findings.title: redeemInstant minimum received is in 18 decimals, not the receive token's decimals, so it cannot carry a ticker.
findings.evidence: RedemptionVaultWithUSTB._redeemInstant: require(amountTokenOutWithoutFee >= minReceiveAmountCopy) with both values in base18. descriptor.json: 'Min receive amount' unit decimals 18, base " ".
findings.fix: Change the label to 'Min receive amount (in receive token)'.

cases.notes: The mTBILL out amount is right, but the asset is not named. The fee part (1.685 mTBILL to feeReceiver) is not shown. The USDC received (2537.37) is bounded by min 0, and the screen states that bound correctly. The allowance spend is not shown.

formats.key: redeemRequest(address tokenOut, uint256 amountMTokenIn, address recipient)
effects: The vault pulls amountMTokenIn minus the fee of the vault's mToken from the signer into its own escrow with transferFrom.
The vault sends a mToken fee (rate from storage) from the signer to feeReceiver.
The vault creates a pending request owned by the recipient. Later the admin approves it at a rate the admin chooses and pays tokenOut from requestRedeemer to the recipient. No minimum is set.
formats.shown: Intent 'request a redemption' with the receive token, the mToken amount as a bare number with no ticker, and the receiver.

findings.title: redeemRequest (with recipient) shows the mToken amount with no token name or ticker.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json: 'mToken Amount In' unit base " ", decimals 18. RedemptionVault._redeemRequest: _tokenTransferFromUser(address(mToken), address(this), calcResult.amountMTokenWithoutFee, 18).
findings.fix: Split the descriptor per mToken vault. Set the unit base to the ticker, or use tokenAmount with a token constant.

findings.title: redeemRequest (with recipient) does not say that a mToken fee goes to feeReceiver now.
findings.fix: Change the label to 'mToken amount (fee included)'.

findings.title: redeemRequest (with recipient) payout amount and timing are set later by the admin. No minimum exists.
findings.evidence: RedemptionVault.approveRequest(requestId, newMTokenRate) onlyVaultAdmin -> _approveRequest: amountTokenOutWithoutFee = (request.amountMToken * newMTokenRate) / request.tokenOutRate; approveRequest has no variation tolerance check.

effects: The vault pulls amountMTokenIn minus the fee of the vault's mToken from the signer into its own escrow with transferFrom. This spends the signer's allowance.
The vault sends a mToken fee (rate from storage) from the signer to feeReceiver.
The vault creates a pending request for the signer. Later the admin approves it at a rate the admin chooses and pays tokenOut from requestRedeemer. No minimum is set.
formats.shown: Intent 'request a redemption' with the receive token and the mToken amount as a bare number with no ticker.

findings.title: redeemRequest does not say that a mToken fee goes to feeReceiver at request time.

findings.title: redeemRequest payout amount and timing are set later by the admin. No minimum is shown or enforced.
findings.evidence: RedemptionVault._approveRequest: amountTokenOutWithoutFee = (request.amountMToken * newMTokenRate) / request.tokenOutRate; newMTokenRate comes from the admin.

findings.title: redeemRequest spends the signer's mToken allowance to the vault. The screen does not say so.
findings.evidence: Case 1: approval event for mTBILL from the signer to the vault 0xf6e51d…4517, new allowance 0, after transferFrom of 119.626 mTBILL.

cases.notes: The mTBILL amount sent to the vault is right, but the asset is not named. The allowance spend is not shown. The reader correctly saw that USDC arrives later.

effects: The vault pulls amountMTokenIn minus the fee of the vault's mToken from the signer into escrow with transferFrom.
The vault sends a fee to feeReceiver from the signer. The fee is fiatAdditionalFee percent plus fiatFlatFee in mToken, both from storage.
The vault creates a pending request with tokenOut set to the zero address (MANUAL_FULLFILMENT_TOKEN). Payment is fiat, off chain, at a rate the admin chooses later. No token arrives on chain.
formats.shown: Intent 'request a redemption' with the mToken amount as a bare number with no ticker.

findings.title: redeemFiatRequest uses the same intent as token requests and never says the payout is off-chain fiat.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json: intent 'request a redemption' for both redeemFiatRequest and redeemRequest. RedemptionVault.redeemFiatRequest: _redeemRequest(MANUAL_FULLFILMENT_TOKEN, amountMTokenIn, true, msg.sender); _approveRequest skips the token transfer when isFiat.
findings.fix: Change the intent to 'Request fiat redemption (paid off-chain)'.

findings.title: redeemFiatRequest shows the mToken amount with no token name or ticker.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json: 'mToken Amount In' unit base " ", decimals 18.
findings.fix: Split the descriptor per mToken vault. Set the unit base to the ticker.

findings.title: redeemFiatRequest does not say that a percent fee plus a flat mToken fee go to feeReceiver.
findings.evidence: RedemptionVault._calcAndValidateRedeem: feeAmount = _getFeeAmount(..., fiatAdditionalFee); if (!waivedFeeRestriction[user]) result.feeAmount += fiatFlatFee; _redeemRequest then sends feeAmount to feeReceiver.
findings.fix: Change the label to 'mToken amount (fees included)'.
